entities.name: Marit Lage
entities.description: A powerful kraken-like avatar being comparable to a demigod, worshiped by cults and imprisoned in the Ronom Glacier.

entities.name: Ronom Glacier
entities.description: The glacier on Dominaria in which Marit Lage was entombed.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane where Marit Lage was imprisoned.

entities.name: Balash Xev
entities.description: A brine shaman who led Marit Lage's cult in Balduvia and was slain by Jaya Ballard.

entities.name: Jaya Ballard
entities.description: A planeswalker who slew Xev and exiled Marit Lage's ice into the Blind Eternities.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: Cast the World Spell, ending the ice age.

entities.name: World Spell
entities.description: Freyalise's spell ending the Ice Age and starting the Flooding of Terisiare.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: Discovered Marit Lage cults and hatched a scheme to gain power over her.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A telepathic planeswalker used as a beacon to lure Marit Lage; killed by her impact.

entities.name: Isona Maive
entities.description: Declared she would not be defeated by Marit Lage.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: Planeswalker who coerced Ral Zarek into returning Marit Lage's prison to Dominaria.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: Coerced by Nahiri into powering a planar gate.

entities.name: Arkol
entities.description: An Argivian scholar who wrongly thought Marit Lage was a planeswalker.

entities.name: Hall of the Hospitallers of the Frozen Heart
entities.description: A cult of Marit Lage founded on Ravnica by an abbot.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: Plane where the icy prison was lured.

entities.name: Blind Eternities
entities.description: Space between planes into which Marit Lage was exiled.

events.summary: Marit Lage pulls herself through the Blind Eternities to Dominaria and is trapped inside the Ronom Glacier.
events.quote: where she emerged inside the Ronom Glacier , causing her to become trapped there.

events.summary: Balash Xev leads her cult in Balduvia, mutating followers; he is slain by Jaya Ballard.
events.quote: He was slain by Jaya Ballard at the end of the Ice Age.

events.summary: Jaya confronts Marit Lage, then exiles the ice and Marit Lage into the Blind Eternities.
events.quote: exiling it and Marit Lage into the Blind Eternities

events.summary: Cults form on many planes in answer to Marit Lage's whispers.
events.quote: She whispered into the minds of any willing to listen, and cults formed on many planes.

events.summary: Tezzeret schemes to gain power over Marit Lage and kill Jace; a physician consecrates himself to her.
events.quote: Tezzeret hatched a scheme that would not only give him power over Marit Lage but also kill Jace Beleren .

events.summary: The abbot kidnaps Jace and uses his mind as a beacon to lure Marit Lage to Ravnica as a comet.
Planeswalkers lure Marit Lage to Amonkhet; her impact kills Jace.
events.quote: Lage's impact killed Jace, but the other planeswalkers escaped to Dominaria.

events.summary: Nahiri coerces Ral Zarek into returning the icy prison to Dominaria, freeing Marit Lage after sixteen centuries.
events.quote: freeing Lage for the first time in sixteen centuries.
